caption: The drawing is on a beige, slightly aged sheet of paper and shows three orthographic views of a table-like structure in pencil. In the upper left, labeled "SIDE ELEVATION," is a rectangular frame 19 1/4 inches high and 14 1/2 inches wide featuring an arch-shaped cutout with an ornate, scalloped edge, supported by two turned legs. In the upper center and right, labeled "FRONT ELEVATION," is a horizontal rectangular table 47 1/2 inches wide, showing ornate panels with a similar scalloped arch motif beneath the top surface, supported by two pairs of turned legs; floral rosettes appear in the ornamentation directly beneath the tabletop at either end. Across the bottom of the page, labeled "PLAN OF TOP," is a top-down rectangle measuring 33 1/2 inches by 19 inches, showing no internal details. The text "PAINTED SURFACE" appears above the "FRONT ELEVATION" view, and "SCALE 1 1/2" = 1' - 0"" appears in the bottom left corner. All lines and text are rendered in light pencil, and the drawing features spots of discoloration along the right margin.
title: Bench
